subject.title: fix(ui): give run state its own color instead of brand red

question: Should the Control UI standardize teal as the semantic color for running session state after reviewing live visual proof across the affected themes?
rationale: The change is intentionally product-visible color semantics, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human decision rather than an automated merge judgment.

options.title: Approve the semantic run token
options.body: Accept the dedicated `--run` token once live evidence confirms active and failed rows remain distinct in the affected themes.

options.title: Choose a different run-state vocabulary
options.body: Request a different named token or palette value if maintainers want another visual meaning for active work before this becomes shared UI semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve the semantic run token
recommendation.body: Accept the dedicated `--run` token once live evidence confirms active and failed rows remain distinct in the affected themes.
